scale_distinction: Slot 2801 models the ~101 µm organ-scale wing spot. Slot 3182 models the 1.8 µm subcellular Turing wavelength of the melanin-granule / ocellus texture inside that patch. The macro photograph cannot resolve 1.8 µm; the wavelength is fixed by the dispersion law, and the photograph anchors the adult phenotype the texture belongs to.
